leave.title: Leave this conversation?

empty.active: You have no active triage conversations for this match.
empty.archived: You have no archived triage conversations for this match.

lifecycle.archivedNotice: This conversation is archived. You can read it, but you cannot ask questions or add agents until you unarchive it.

archive.title: Archive this conversation?
archive.message: The conversation leaves your active list and stays readable under Archived, with its questions, advice, and lineage unchanged. Nobody can ask questions or add agents until you unarchive it. Questions that are still being answered finish normally.

unarchive.title: Unarchive this conversation?
unarchive.message: The conversation returns to your active list and accepts new questions and agents again.

delete.title: Delete this conversation permanently?
delete.message: Deleting is permanent and cannot be undone. All questions and advice of this conversation are removed, questions that are still being answered are stopped, and nobody can open the conversation afterwards.

refusal.notPermitted: Only Club Admins and Coaches of the team can archive, unarchive, or delete conversations.
refusal.failed: The conversation could not be changed. Try again.

conflict.message: The conversation changed in the meantime, so nothing was changed. Reload it to see its current state.

unavailable.title: Conversation unavailable
unavailable.message: This conversation is not available. It may have been deleted, or it is not one of your conversations.
unavailable.service: The conversation could not be changed because the platform is unavailable. Nothing was changed. Try again later.

lifecycle.offline: Managing conversations needs a connection. Reconnect to continue.
lifecycle.unknownOutcome: We could not confirm the result. Reload the conversation to see its current state.
